```objc HKQuantityType *quantityType = [HKObjectType quantityTypeForIdentifier:HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate]; HKUnit *bpm = [HKUnit unitFromString:@"count/min"]; HKQuantity *quantity = [HKQuantity quantityWithUnit:bpm doubleValue:72.0]; HKQuantitySample *sample = [HKQuantitySample quantitySampleWithType:quantityType quantity:quantity startDate:start endDate:end]; ```
